lead_html: Bridge art — redraw of all 12 (owner by card 2026-10-21: Redraw all 12 now). Each row is one piece GPT's review asked to redraw, or a drawbridge piece whose render never arrived. The reference picture beside a row is today's art; the lettered columns are the new candidates. Pick a letter, or note what to change. Nothing is installed until you pick.
